:::{#exm-set-builder}
#### Even die rolls in set-builder notation

$\set{x \in \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} : x \text{ is even}} = \set{2, 4, 6}$
is the set of [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd) rolls,
and $\set{x \in \reals : x > 0}$ is the set of positive [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers).

:::
